title: Port Mahon Rising
author: Mara Joubert
blurb: Mirabel Crane, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
